# Collation in table functions and external tables, and the documented limitations on them.
# The documented messages differ in spelling from the ones GoogleSQL gives, as they do for UDFs
# in ../errors/collation.txt, so the cases match only their common part.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/collation-concepts.md

# Table functions support collation: an output column keeps its collation.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.tvf_ci_output() AS (SELECT COLLATE('a', 'und:ci') AS c);
SELECT c = 'A' FROM scalars.tvf_ci_output()
=> "true"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.tvf_ci_argument(x STRING) AS (SELECT x AS c);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scalars.tvf_ci_argument(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'))
=> error contains: on argument of TVF call

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.tvf_ci_explicit(x STRING) RETURNS TABLE<output_str STRING> AS (SELECT COLLATE(x, 'und:ci') AS output_str);
SELECT 1
=> error contains: on output column output_str

CREATE OR REPLACE EXTERNAL TABLE scalars.external_ci (c STRING COLLATE 'und:ci') OPTIONS (format = 'CSV', uris = ['gs://bucket/data.csv']);
SELECT 1
=> error:
